description: Searches Australian media from the past 24 hours for all articles mentioning NDIS, National Disability Insurance Scheme, or disability; extracts article title, URL, publication name, author, date, and key content details

articles.title: NDIS costs projected to rise in new budget estimates
articles.author: John Doe
articles.content_summary: New budget estimates show NDIS costs are projected to rise by 8% in the coming financial year. The Parliamentary Budget Office released the figures alongside revised participant growth numbers. The government says reforms will help manage growth while maintaining support quality.
